maintenance_led.reason: Sells identity verification and fraud-prevention software (MiVIP, MiPass, Digital Fraud Defender) to banks and fintechs, not repair or replacement work.

publicly_funded.reason: Customers are private banks, building societies and businesses such as ABN AMRO, Nationwide and Turo, not government.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows mainly by selling its own identity platform and products; acquisitions have been occasional, not a steady roll-up.

mission_critical.reason: Identity verification and authentication embedded via API/SDK into onboarding and login, supporting KYC/AML compliance; switching means re-integration and compliance risk.
